note: Story status is blank, traced normally; there is no OCMS flow deck. The story asks OCMS to check PLUS for recent appeals per ID within X months (parameter), with the address in the appeal and the appeal date, then show them as a listing. There is no code for this: the PLUS integration in the repo is inbound only (PLUS calls plus-* endpoints in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi, e.g. PlusIntegrationController); no outbound call from OCMS to PLUS to read appeals was found, there is no 'X months' appeal parameter, and the appeal address is not stored/shown as appeal data. No maintenance ticket touches this feature. PLUS protection via APIM: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim. OCMS has no appeal check against PLUS, no X-months parameter and no listing; only inbound endpoints for PLUS exist.

steps.step: After 'Generate Work Order' is clicked, OCMS triggers an appeal check against PLUS
steps.detail: There is no Generate Work Order button/endpoint (see OCMS34.6), so there is no trigger for a PLUS check.

steps.step: OCMS queries PLUS for recent appeals from the ID
steps.detail: The PLUS integration in the repo is inbound: PlusIntegrationController (@RequestMapping :33, @PostMapping /plus-furnish-redirect-check :65) serves calls FROM PLUS for furnish/redirect, as do plus-apply-suspension and plus-offence-notice in ocmsadminprivateapi. No client/RestTemplate/WebClient from OCMS to PLUS to read appeals by ID was found (grep appeal+address, PLUS url/base find nothing). ocms.plus.key.validation.enabled=false in prod (application-prod.properties:60); real protection via APIM: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The X-months window is configurable through a parameter maintained in OCMS
steps.detail: No 'last X months' parameter or constant for appeals was found in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or ocmsadminui (grep appeal+month finds nothing). The only PLUS property is subscription key validation (application-prod.properties:60).

steps.step: OCMS retrieves the address indicated in the appeal and the appeal date
steps.detail: Nothing stores or reads an appeal address/date from PLUS. The inbound PLUS endpoints receive furnish/suspension from PLUS and do not provide appeal data for OCMS to fetch.

steps.step: Results are captured in a listing displayed on screen for work order preparation
steps.detail: Same as OCMS34.7 step 5: no listing; the Workorder Reports grid is commented out (ReportList.tsx:147-201) and has no appeal columns.
